newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CARDIFF WIN WELSH CUP.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CARDIFF WIN WELSH CUP.

text.p: Cardiff won rugby union's Welsh Cup when they beat Swansea 33-26 on Saturday in the last ever game at Cardiff Arms Park.
After Swansea had led 14-9 at halftime Cardiff stormed into a 33-14 lead midway through the second half.
Swansea launched a strong fightback, tries by Mark Taylor and Steve Moore setting up a tense finish. But Cardiff held out to clinch the cup for the seventh time.
The best of the game's seven tries was a dazzling 50-metre run by former Welsh international winger Nigel Walker.
The bulldozers will now move in to demolish the ground. A a new one will be built on the site for the 1999 World Cup.
